text_en: When Solomon had ended his prayer, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the temple.
text_cn: 撒罗满祈祷完了，有火从天上降下，焚烧了全燔祭和其他的牺牲；上主的荣耀充满了圣殿。

text_en: The priests could not enter the house of the Lord , because the glory of the Lord filled the Lord ’s house.
text_cn: 由于上主的荣耀充满了上主的殿，司祭不能进入上主的殿。

text_en: When all the people of Israel saw the fire come down and the glory of the Lord on the temple, they bowed down on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and worshiped and gave thanks to the Lord , saying, “For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever. ”
text_cn: 所有的以色列子民看见有火降下，上主的荣耀充满了圣殿，便俯伏在石铺的地上，叩拜称颂上主说：“因为他是圣善的，因为他的仁慈永远常存。”

text_en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before the Lord .
text_cn: 君王和众百姓在上主面前祭杀了牺牲。

text_en: King Solomon offered as a sacrifice twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
text_cn: 撒罗满王那时祭杀了二万二千头牛，十二万只羊；这样君王和全百姓为上主的圣殿行了奉献礼。

text_en: The priests stood at their posts; the Levites also, with the instruments for music to the Lord that King David had made for giving thanks to the Lord —for his steadfast love endures forever—whenever David offered praises by their ministry. Opposite them the priests sounded trumpets; and all Israel stood.
text_cn: 司祭各站在自己的岗位上，肋未人拿着达味王所制的上主的乐器，奏“因为他的仁慈永远常存”称颂上主的歌；这赞美歌是达味令他们唱的；司祭们面对着他们吹号筒，同时全以色列人都站立不动。

text_en: Solomon consecrated the middle of the court that was in front of the house of the Lord ; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the offerings of well-being because the bronze altar Solomon had made could not hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat parts.
text_cn: 撒罗满祝圣了上主殿前的内院，在那里，献了全燔祭与和平祭的脂油，因为他制造的铜坛容不下那么多全燔祭、素祭和脂油。

text_en: At that time Solomon held the festival for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.
text_cn: 那时，撒罗满举行庆节七天之久，所有由哈玛特渡口到埃及小河的以色列百姓，都与他在一起，实是一大集会。

text_en: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly; for they had observed the dedication of the altar seven days and the festival seven days.
text_cn: 第八天又举行了盛大的集会，如此举行献坛礼七天，过节七天。

text_en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their homes, joyful and in good spirits because of the goodness that the Lord had shown to David and to Solomon and to his people Israel.
text_cn: 七月二十三日，君王遣散了民众。他们因上主对达味、撒罗满和他的百姓以色列所施的恩惠，都满怀欢乐，回了自己的帐幕。

text_en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord and the king’s house; all that Solomon had planned to do in the house of the Lord and in his own house he successfully accomplished.
text_cn: 撒罗满完成了上主的殿和王宫，凡撒罗满心中要在上主的殿和自己的宫内所作的，都顺利完成了。

text_en: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon in the night and said to him: “I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place for myself as a house of sacrifice.
text_cn: 夜间上主显示给撒罗满，对他说：“我已听了你的祈祷，我也为我拣选了这地方作为祭祀的大殿。

text_en: When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command the locust to devour the land, or send pestilence among my people,
text_cn: 我如果使天闭塞不雨，或使蝗虫吞吃这地，或使瘟疫在我百姓中间流行，

text_en: if my people who are called by my name humble themselves, pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin and heal their land.
text_cn: 这称为我名下的百姓，如果谦逊祈祷，寻求我的面，远离自己的恶行，我必从天上俯听，宽恕他们的罪过，使他们的土地生产。

text_en: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.
text_cn: 自今以后，我必睁眼垂顾，侧耳谛听在此处发出的祈祷。

text_en: For now I have chosen and consecrated this house so that my name may be there forever; my eyes and my heart will be there for all time.
text_cn: 现今我已选择这殿，予以祝圣，使我的名永远在这殿中；我的眼和我的心，也时时留在那里。

text_en: As for you, if you walk before me, as your father David walked, doing according to all that I have commanded you and keeping my statutes and my ordinances,
text_cn: 至于你，如果你在我面前行走，像你父亲达味那样行走，遵行我吩咐你的一切，恪守我的法律和典章，

text_en: then I will establish your royal throne, as I made covenant with your father David saying, ‘You shall never lack a successor to rule over Israel. ’
text_cn: 我必巩固你的王位，一如我应许你父亲达味所说：你的子孙中，决断不了有人作以色列的统治者。

text_en: “But if you turn aside and forsake my statutes and my commandments that I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and worship them,
text_cn: 但是，如果你们远离我，离弃我在你们前所颁布的法律和诫命，而去服侍敬拜别的神，

text_en: then I will pluck you up from the land that I have given you; and this house, which I have consecrated for my name, I will cast out of my sight, and will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
text_cn: 我必将你们从我赐予你们的地上根除，且要抛弃这座为我名而祝圣的殿，毫不顾惜，使它成为万民的笑谈和话柄。

text_en: And regarding this house, now exalted, everyone passing by will be astonished, and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this house? ’
text_cn: 这殿虽然宏大，凡经过的人必将惊愕说：上主为什么这样对待了这地方和这座殿？

text_en: Then they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the Lord the God of their ancestors who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they adopted other gods, and worshiped them and served them; therefore he has brought all this calamity upon them. ’”
text_cn: 人必回答说：是因为他们离弃了领他们出离埃及地的上主，他们祖先的天主，而归依、崇拜、服侍了别的神；为此，上主使这一切灾祸临到他们身上。”
